arStrings.szText: {c_highlight}Sanctification{/c} grants an item a random property. The effect can be powerful, but the process is irreversible. It becomes {C_highlight}Unmodifiable{/c}, and cannot be changed.
After slaying a Lesser Evil in Pre-torment there is a chance a portal to the {C_highlight}Heavenly Forge{/c} will appear, where you can {c_highlight}Sanctify{/c} your equipment.
Earn {c_highlight}Heavenly Sigils{/c} by completing activities in Torment. Activate them to teleport to the {c_highlight}Heavenly Forge{/c}.
